summary.text: Stacy Jo Adams is a Republican who represents Oklahoma House District 50, which includes Jefferson and Stephens counties. She was elected for the 60th Legislature and appointed vice chair of the Insurance Committee.

paragraphs.text: Adams attended Cameron University before beginning a career in the insurance industry, where she opened her own insurance agency in Duncan, Oklahoma.
The Speaker also appointed her to the Appropriations and Budget Public Safety Subcommittee, the Commerce and Economic Development Oversight Committee, and the General Government Committee.
Her House biography lists her primary policy areas as supporting military members and veterans, defending the sanctity of life, and standing for first responders, farmers and small business owners.
Adams and her husband, Ricky, have been married for 14 years and are parents to seven boys.
The family attends the Grand Assembly in Corum, where she teaches Sunday School.
